dimensions.name: injection_susceptibility_ladder
dimensions.description: Highest L1/L2/L3 payload that converted session into bait interaction. 3 = full privilege-escalation. 0 = no conversion.

dimensions.name: retry_backoff_shape
dimensions.description: Coefficient of retry interval decay (exponential vs linear vs burst). Reveals agent framework retry logic.

dimensions.name: loop_discipline_score
dimensions.description: Resistance to non-decaying loops (pagination trap). 0% = runaway agent; 100% = self-terminating.
dimensions.note: Direct measurement of 'Safety Does Not Compose' class vulnerability.

dimensions.name: token_burn_ceiling_estimate
dimensions.note: Economic ceiling probe — measures attacker resource limits.

dimensions.name: credential_use_evidence
dimensions.note: Direct proof of malicious execution (not just scanning).

dimensions.name: persistence_attempt_evidence
dimensions.note: When-Context-Gets-Root privesc behavior captured live. Both = highest-capability signature.

dimensions.name: canary_propagation_score
dimensions.description: Evidence that a canary phrase planted in this session appears in later sessions or downstream outputs of the same actor cluster — memory-poisoning / pipeline-tracking measurement.
dimensions.note: The tracking pixel for AI agents.

dimensions.name: interactive_depth_stage
dimensions.note: How far the attacker progressed through our engagement ladder before bail/termination.

dimensions.name: honeypot_probe_signal
dimensions.note: Detects agents actively testing whether this surface is a honeypot (repeated tools/list diffing, deliberate malformed calls, latency measurement, canary-string hunting). Direct input to Evolution Engine fidelity fixes.

dimensions.name: security_posture_score_composite
dimensions.description: Aggregated threat score from dimensions 1-23 (weighted ensemble). Determines alert tier: 0-25=low, 26-60=medium, 61-85=high, 86-100=critical.
dimensions.note: Final composite for alert tier assignment.
